before: Shape fill and outline change only through the setShapeFill and setShapeOutline commands and the Shape.fill automation API.
after: The Format shape pane in React and Vue, the image.formatShape toolbar slot, and the context menu row run the same setShapeFill and setShapeOutline commands on the selected shape. The pane reads snapshot().image.shapeFormat, so a remote edit repaints it and a deleted shape empties it.
